// NEGATIVE fixture — `new AbortController()` only where a lexer must not see it.
import { makeAbortController } from '../../../lib/fetch-compat.mjs';

// A line comment: new AbortController()
/* A block comment: new AbortController() */
const SINGLE = 'new AbortController()';
const DOUBLE = "new AbortController()";
const TEMPLATE = `call makeAbortController(), never new AbortController()`;
const IN_REGEX = /new\s+AbortController\b/;

export function mentionsAbortCtor(source) {
  return /new\s+AbortController\b/.test(source);
}

export function makeSignal() {
  const controller = makeAbortController();
  return controller.signal;
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
